title: Signature Carbon-Aware Placement
description: Signature Carbon-Aware Placement is a scheduling ability in the Signature Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Places jobs in regions where the grid is cleanest right now. Grid carbon intensity feeds the placer; jobs shift to low-carbon regions when possible. It takes carbon feed and produces placements. Tunable parameters: gCO2/kWh. Guarantee: placements never violate data residency. This record is a Signature-authored completion — an original design of the JAH system, clearly labeled Signature, and not presented as a harvested public record.
